answer: Garden-tenure apprenticeship: a new identity starts as an apprentice tending a garden plot of real network tasks under a randomly assigned senior mentor, rotated every epoch so no farm can pair its puppets with friendly mentors. The mentor's rewards sit in escrow against the apprentice's later fraud, and a delta of failed audits across the reef of peer reviewers ejects apprentice and mentor stake. A Sybil farmer must fund a full epoch of supervised work per puppet and bribe a rotating stranger each time, so cost scales linearly with every fake identity while honest newcomers pay only time.
